title: Am I Not a Man? Contemporary Issues in Black Men's Health
description:
Prerequisite: HLTH 140: Intro to Personal and Community Health or Permission of the SPHL-Department of Behavioral and Community Health.
Recommended: HLTH 200, HLTH 230, and FMSC 190.
Restriction: Must be in a major within SPHL-Behavioral & Community Health Department or obtain permission from the instructor.
